scope: Public official MCP landing page, CLI contracts and agent skill source. Documentation review, not an authenticated editing-session trace.

findings.observed: Generation and editing workflows have separate discovery contracts. Agents inspect the selected schema before submitting.
findings.aftertake: Route a request to region transform, reference animation, character transfer or film editing before constructing parameters.
findings.implementationStatus: Local MCP editing guide, typed film media roles and current beat-plan schema are implemented. Generic image/video generation intent routing remains pending.

findings.observed: Media slots have distinct roles; previous completed jobs can be reused as references. The public media guide describes itself as mirroring MCP media handling.
findings.aftertake: Expose source, subject, appearance, ending frame and audio as explicit typed inputs. Resolve each by verified hash.
findings.implementationStatus: MCP film assets, completed takes and voices have separate typed identities and verified hashes. Generation reference roles are not exposed through MCP yet.

findings.observed: The explainer workflow generates narration before visuals, binds each visual/audio pair explicitly and assembles a final film.
findings.aftertake: Generalize the reviewed narration-first beat ledger into a persistent edit plan with measured voice duration, picture interval and editable title layers. Do not force its explainer-specific ten-second blocks onto cinematic edits.
findings.implementationStatus: Persistent general beat plans now measure whole narration, bind pictures/captions, reject insufficient coverage and compile an editable native film. A real three-beat MCP proof and native UI import were verified.

findings.observed: Recovery rejoins an existing timed-out job, regenerates only failed blocks and changes parameters after repeated identical failures.
findings.aftertake: Persist stage/job identities and approved assets. Resume known work; do not duplicate generation after a client timeout. Revisions should target the changed shot or title.
findings.implementationStatus: Native film idempotency, exact voice reuse and actual MCP-client reconnection were verified. Whole-edit generative-stage dependency tracking remains pending.
